antlr4-python3-runtime 4.11.1 (BSD-3-Clause), pure Python, copied from PyPI unchanged. Used only by opt_math/grading/third_party/matharena/parser.py to load sympy's LaTeX parser; the environment's antlr4 4.9 (needed by hydra/omegaconf) is left in place.
Note: the PyPI 4.11.1 wheel ships no LICENSE file; this is the standard ANTLR BSD-3-Clause text named in each source header.
